text:
lina: Heads up — windows CMake CI started failing after yesterday's windows-builder image roll (default generator switched to Ninja). Failing link errors in third_party/native_plugin. Repro on my fork.

lina: Error snippet:
```
LINK : fatal error LNK1104: cannot open file 'native_plugin.lib'
native_plugin.obj : error LNK2019: unresolved external symbol plugin_init referenced in function main
```

lina: Full build log: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/12345 

raj: @lina can you paste the cmake command/CMakeCache? Suspect clang-cl vs MSVC flags not being forwarded when generator changed.

lina: CMake call I used:
```
cmake -G Ninja -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=cl -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang-cl -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo ..
ninja native_plugin
```

ci-bot: Build 12345 failed: windows-cmake-clangcl-ninja — https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/12345/logs (exit code 1)

sam: Re-run queued (I'll keep an eye on it).

buildkite: Re-run triggered by sam — https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/12346

katie: This smells like a missing IMPORT_LIBRARY or an incorrect INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES propagation when switching generators. Ninja + clang-cl can change how LINK_FLAGS are applied.

raj: Quick local check: if the imported target has IMPORTED_IMPLIB or IMPORTED_LOCATION unset, MSVC linker won't find the .lib. Can you check targets in the generated native_plugin.ninja?

lina: grabbed the generated ninja file — native_plugin link line omits /IMPLIB:... and only passes the .dll path. Looks like our add_library(...) for the vendor lib was marked IMPORTED with only IMPORTED_LOCATION.

sam: I re-ran with the older windows-builder image (pre-roll) and it linked fine. So image change probably flipped default generator or CMake version which affects imported target handling.

raj: I'll open a tiny patch to toolchain.cmake to ensure when CMAKE_GENERATOR contains "Ninja" and CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID == "Clang" and MSVC is present, we explicitly set IMPORTED_IMPLIB for imported SHARED libs.

lina: Sounds good. Can you also bisect which image change introduced it? I started a quick bisect across images but it's noisy.

ci-bot: Build 12346 (re-run) completed: failed — https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/12346/logs

raj: PR up: https://git.redwood/infratoolchain/+/987 — tiny guard for imported implib, adds a test for generator permutations.

katie: Will review. We should also add a CI matrix job that runs both "Ninja + clang-cl" and "NMake + cl" to catch this. Filing ticket to track test coverage.

lina: filing bisect ticket and regression label. @ci-bot please add label 'regression:windows' and link logs.

ci-bot: label added: regression:windows; ticket created INFRA-789; logs attached.

sam: LGTM on quickfix after one review. Patch passes on my local VM with new image.

katie: Approved, merging quickfix to main. Follow-up: add integration test + notify platform/runtime teams.

lina: Merged. Thanks everyone — will follow up in #eng-platform to ping downstream consumers.

raj: Thanks — I'll queue a backport to the release branch.
